blinding_note: No proper-motion values were read. Catalogue columns used: ra, dec, pmra_error, pmdec_error, pmra_pmdec_corr. Scan law: ra/dec/scan_angle of FOV1 and FOV2 and jd_time.

scan_law.content: commanded_scan_law.csv.gz (2.49 GB), 10 s sampling, 34,504,372 rows, 2014-07-25 to 2025-06-30 (jd_time - 2455197.5 = 1666.4 .. 5660.0); the commanded attitude can differ from the realised one by up to ~30 arcsec (per the data description)

commands: python3 L3_scan_law_template.py --zip <zip> --fits <fits> --out L3_SCAN_LAW_RESULT_FULLMISSION.json (run with the script version before the --jdmax option was added; the option does not change the unrestricted path)
operator.model: per HEALPix pixel (nside 16) information tensor M = <u u^T>, u=(sin theta, cos theta) in (east,north) over FOV1+FOV2 transits; predicted sigma_alpha*/sigma_delta = sqrt(<cos^2>/<sin^2>), corr = -<sin cos>/sqrt(<sin^2><cos^2>)

interpretation: Sign and orientation conventions of the scan angle (0 = North, 90 = East) are confirmed: predictions correlate positively with the catalogue's own per-pixel error ellipses (r = 0.87 for the axis ratio and 0.81 for the pmra-pmdec correlation in the DR3 window).

Restricting the scan law to the DR3 interval improves the axis-ratio agreement (r 0.79 -> 0.87), consistent with the catalogue being built from the first 34 months; the full-mission law is therefore not the right template for DR3 quantities.

The slopes are below 1 (0.67 axis ratio, 0.80 correlation): the catalogue's ellipses are less anisotropic than the pure along-scan prediction. Not explained here (candidates: isotropic noise floor/excess noise, across-scan information, per-source scatter around the pixel median). The template therefore explains direction and sign of the error anisotropy (r^2 ~0.76 and ~0.66) but not its amplitude.

claims.claim: The commanded scan law reproduces the sign and orientation of Gaia DR3 per-pixel proper-motion error ellipses for CRF3 sources.
claims.limit: r=0.87/0.81; amplitude not reproduced (slopes 0.67/0.80); commanded not realised attitude

claims.claim: A scan-pattern systematics template for mode fitting is available.
claims.limit: per-pixel information tensor only; the mapping from scan-pattern anisotropy to correlated systematic vector-field errors is NOT built
